scope: Research targets fixed before symmetric1 starts; targets are not an automatic deployment approval or a claim of paper fidelity

performance.scope: Paired against frozen original and weak980; per-case failures, pauses and force peaks must be retained even if averages pass

required: Both left and right side views on flat terrain
Whole-flight ascending and descending standard stairs
Review least successful and high-contact trials as well as representative passes
criteria: Both front legs contribute coordinated stepping
No persistent dragging or leg collapse
No extended pause or repeated stair-edge catching
visual_review.scope: Recordings supplement paired quantitative measurements; saved-pose playback labeled separately from new physics
